description: Restores active-task visibility and adds direct completion guidance for analysis-only tasks.
changelog:
**Fixes:**
- Projects one unique developer-owned resumable task as read-only workflow context when no session pointer exists.
- Analysis-only research, audit, and design tasks can complete declared evidence work directly from planning and archive without entering implementation.
notes: No project migration is required. Existing projects can run the normal trellis update flow.
